crossRefs.note: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

people.name: Reu
people.line: Son of Peleg, ancestor of Abraham

people.name: Serug
people.line: Son of Reu; father of Nahor, ancestor of Abraham

translations.web: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
translations.bsb: And after he had become the father of Serug, Reu lived 207 years and had other sons and daughters.
translations.kjv: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.
translations.asv: and Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.
